top_signals.title: Asian Stocks Steady in Runup to Fed, Oil Declines: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks steadied after four days of losses as investors held back ahead of the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate decision, with markets expecting its first hike since 2023. Oil declined, supporting gains in regional bonds.
